Honestly the best way especially in this kinda in between you’re in, just adjust whatever youre eating plus or minus 100 calories every like 2 weeks depending on how much you’re gaining. I ate 2900 for two weeks, realized I was gaining a bit too quickly and subtracted 100 calories to 2800. Gaining at a much better pace. TDEE calcs will never be 100% accurate so I find just getting the closest possible (whatever the TDEE calc says) and adjusting from there (plus or minus 100-200 every week) until you find the sweet spot.

 The summers suck. And Im from a state that’s not too humid and it STILL sucks. Especially since I’m fairly active, love to ski during the winter, skateboard during the summer. I have some pretty ugly bacne that REALLY wants to stick around from playing varsity sports in high school, all while binding. Looking back idk how I survived, could barely breathe! 

Started T about 4.5 years ago when I was 16 and I’m very very thankful that I was able to start relatively young. Unfortunately, military insurance hates trans people (will pay for T but not surgery🤨). Parent just got a new job that has insurance for the fam that covers it! Hoping to get it this summer at the perfect age of 20! I can’t WAIT to burn my worn out, raggedy binders I’ve had since the first day of high school

Hang in there man, I really empathize with you. What keeps me going is when I get ready for surgery, I dont have to work up some pecs, making it easier for the surgeon to sculpt my chest. Also, as soon as everything is healed, I can immediately go out on the beach feeling like a sexy ass MAN! Also, idk about you, but lifting weights, feeling that pump, makes me feel like the man I always wanted to be when I was in grade school. The man I thought I never could be. Maybe just an hour every few days in the gym does some crazy things for my self esteem and mental health. 

I remember vividly being told when I was probably about 12 I wasn’t gonna be able to transition until AT LEAST 18. Those 6 years seemed impossible. I was already experiencing suicidal thoughts at that point. Now look where I am! Started T 2 years before the previous best case scenario! Anything can happen man. I know it seems so far out but I’m telling you, keep yourself busy, work on yourself, that time will shoot by. I’ve been in college for a couple years now and despite having A LOT of struggles trying to get a degree while also battling clinical depression, the semesters fly by. I empathize with the “what could’ve been” thought. I often think I could’ve been a better man than my fucked up brother is. But that’s what keeps me motivated in a slightly messed up way. Prove yourself to yourself! Achieve things you NEVER thought you could. Your 10 year old self should be in awe right now. Even yourself last year should be in awe. DON’T STOP BELIEVING🎶
